Count the calls on each of your numbers over a window, and how many connected,
worked out here from the call list. Connected means the call was answered
(it has an answer_time), whatever its hangup cause; on an inbound call that
means Plivo answered it. A number is the one on your side: from_number on an
outbound call, to_number on an inbound one. Rows are a number and a direction;
--by direction groups by direction alone, --by none gives the totals only.

The window is the calls that ended in it, set as in `plivo voice calls list`: UTC,
at most 31 days, within the last 90. With neither --since nor --until it is
the last 7 days; --until needs --since. Calls that are a child leg of another
(they have a parent_call_uuid) are left out and counted as legs_excluded;
--include-legs counts them.

--number reads one number's outbound calls and its inbound calls, two reads of
the list, and can't be combined with --from, --to or --direction.

The list is read 20 calls a request, one request at a time, and stops after
--max-calls (0: no cap), saying so and exiting 0 with truncated set. Narrow the
window or add --number to read less. Spend is not worked out here: see
`plivo account usage`.

-o json has window, filters, totals and groups (window.covered_since is the
earliest end_time actually read); -o jsonl and -o csv write one record per group.

Usage:
  plivo voice calls stats [flags]

Examples:
  plivo voice calls stats --since 2026-11-01
  plivo voice calls stats --number +14155550100 --since 2026-11-01 -o json --query data.totals
  plivo voice calls stats --by direction

Flags:
      --by string          group rows by number|direction|none (default "number")
      --direction string   inbound|outbound
      --from string        filter by from_number
      --from-date string   same as --since
  -h, --help               help for stats
      --include-legs       count child legs too (calls with a parent_call_uuid)
      --max-calls int      stop after reading this many calls (0: no cap) (default 10000)
      --number string      one of your numbers (E.164): its outbound and inbound calls (not with --from, --to or --direction)
      --since string       calls ending at or after this UTC time (YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM[:SS]]), within the last 90 days, at most 31 days per request
      --to string          filter by to_number
      --to-date string     same as --until
      --until string       calls ending at or before this UTC time (YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM[:SS]])

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            preview requests and local changes without sending or writing anything
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json|jsonl|yaml|csv (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
      --query string       JMESPath filter on the JSON output, e.g. 'data.objects[].call_uuid' (implies -o json)
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --schema             describe the command (arguments, flags, output fields) instead of running it
      --show-secrets       show auth tokens and passwords in API responses instead of [REDACTED]
      --timeout duration   request timeout: seconds, or a duration such as 90s or 2m (default 30s)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
